findings.claim: None of the visible hunks touch how `SuppressSourceGeneration` is handled. The type-collector changes only add `continue` after the mixed-key MsgPack005 report and replace `Dictionary.Add` with a `ContainsKey` guard. Both avoid an analyzer crash for every type, suppressed or not. If the 3.1.1 regression is that types with `SuppressSourceGeneration = true` are skipped by the analyzer, then plain violations still go unreported. An example is a missing `[Key]` (MsgPack004) on a well-formed suppressed type. In that case the first acceptance criterion is not met. Only the crash paths would be fixed.
